text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, amlodipine besylate is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 155 units (14.2 days on hand); Corvale General holds 328.26 units (24.4 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 68382012205 lists Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3002984011) as a registered plant. Inspection 1088772 ended 2019-05-03, classified OAI with 14 Form 483 observations. A Warning Letter was issued to that plant on 2019-10-29. The most recent inspection (1177670) ended 2022-08-05, classified VAI. A second registered plant (FEI 3005430968) received a Warning Letter on 2026-06-02.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately two to three weeks at present use. No FDA shortage listing exists. Two manufacturing sites associated with this product have recent Warning Letters. Alternative suppliers are not on the FDA shortage list but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with A-S Medication Solutions, Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, and American Health Packaging; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and inspection updates weekly; requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer to request plant identification from alternative suppliers' regulatory contacts; requires procurement manager approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
